messages.author: c3d98081d40c4199
messages.subject: Rhipe 0.73.1 incompatible with protobuf 2.5?
parts:
Hello,

  I am trying to install Rhipe on a mac.  I have protobuf v. 2.5:

>pkg-config --modversion protobuf
2.5.0

  When I type : "R CMD INSTALL Rhipe_0.73.1.tar", I get:

llvm-g++-4.2 -arch x86_64 -I/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/include -DNDEBUG  -I/usr/local/include    -fPIC  -mtune=core2 -g -O2  -I.  -mtune=core2 -g -O2  -DUSEAUTOSHORT -DHAVE_UINTPTR_T    `/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R CMD config --cppflags` `pkg-config --cflags protobuf` -c rexp.pb.cc -o rexp.pb.o
In file included from rexp.pb.cc:4:
rexp.pb.h:17:2: error: #error This file was generated by an older version of protoc which is
rexp.pb.h:18:2: error: #error incompatible with your Protocol Buffer headers. Please
rexp.pb.h:19:2: error: #error regenerate this file with a newer version of protoc.
make: *** [rexp.pb.o] Error 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘Rhipe’
* removing ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/Rhipe’


    How do I regenerate that file?  Thank you.

    Natalia

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Rhipe 0.73.1 incompatible with protobuf 2.5?
parts:
Yes it is incompatible. The rearch branch of RHIPE on github is being actively developed to make it work with PB 2.5
